Label.text: Glasses mode uses a dedicated Faceclaw profile and native band input. Phone mode restores your previous Air Gestures profile. All phone controls, profiles, handwriting, practice, drawings and firmware screens remain in the band manager.

In glasses mode, hold index pinch to return to phone mode. In your phone profile, assign Faceclaw: toggle glasses / phone mode to a gesture you choose, so you can switch back without touching the phone.

Connect your band in Air Gestures and G2 in Faceclaw. Index tap selects, middle tap goes back, swipes navigate, and index double tap opens a pinned draft. Review text and explicitly confirm delivery; delivery can run an action in the original app.

Meta sign-in has isolated cookies. Owner keys and account sessions are excluded from backup. Handwriting can edit the focused phone field through Air Gestures accessibility; glasses-only handwriting capture remains unfinished. Physical mode switching has not been verified on hardware.
